fixtures.title: [FIXTURE] Support safely removing unused blueprints
fixtures.body:
Source scenario: https://github.com/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp/issues/2329

Spook can report unused Home Assistant blueprints, but HA-MCP cannot currently remove them. Add a supported way for an agent to delete an unused blueprint without enabling broad filesystem-write tools.

The design must reject deletion when an automation or script still uses the blueprint and should return an actionable error identifying consumers. Home Assistant exposes `blueprint/delete` over WebSocket, while HA-MCP currently wires list, import and save only.

fixtures.title: [FIXTURE] Let agents clean up blueprints reported as unused
fixtures.body:
Source scenario: https://github.com/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp/issues/2329

When Spook reports an unused blueprint, ChatGPT can diagnose the issue but cannot finish the cleanup through HA-MCP. Please add a blueprint removal capability so the user does not need to click through the UI.

Deletion should be safe and should not require enabling the generic File & YAML Tools feature.

fixtures.title: [FIXTURE] Discover HA-MCP natively inside Home Assistant
fixtures.body:
Source scenario: https://github.com/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp/issues/2307
Upstream reference: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/180378

Home Assistant is adding native MCP discovery. Explore exposing HA-MCP through that mechanism so users can manage Home Assistant from an agent running inside Home Assistant.

The upstream work is expected after the 2026.9 release. The desired deployment and compatibility behavior are not yet specified.

fixtures.title: [FIXTURE] Reduce CI runner contention without losing coverage
fixtures.body:
Source scenario: https://github.com/homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp/issues/2311

A single pull-request push currently schedules roughly forty CI jobs against a twenty-runner concurrency cap. Two active PRs can starve each other.

Candidate changes include combining fast checks, consolidating CodeQL, preserving gates only where matrix skip semantics require them, and reducing duplicate E2E executions while keeping deployment-mode coverage. Any proposal must preserve required-check behavior and make individual failures easy to diagnose.
